تستنصرون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْصِرُونَ (tastanṣirūna) /tas.tan.sˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
# تُسْتَنْصَرُونَ (tustanṣarūna) /tus.tan.sˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْصَرَ (istanṣara)
